project_name: 黄小咕 IP，一只黄色鸡，整体外轮廓为拇指体块鸡形吉祥物的拟物角色
identity_structure: 整体外轮廓必须是拇指体块与黄色小鸡融合的一体化造型
正面和背面视角都应看到尾巴呈现
侧面视角可以看不到尾巴，这是正常结构
角色没有手，也没有额外翅膀，只有脚
鸡冠、黄色主体、橙色嘴和橙色脚必须稳定保留
角色要保持圆润、玩具感、可爱且有品牌吉祥物完成度
identity_forbidden: 禁止长出手臂、手掌、人类手指
禁止长出额外翅膀或常规鸡翅
禁止把角色变成普通圆鸡而失去拇指体块轮廓
禁止正面或背面视角尾巴消失
禁止脸部五官漂移、比例突变、材质突变
禁止写实动物羽毛质感，保持干净 3D 吉祥物质感
notes: final frame poster is the only world-reference mother image; use it directly as world, scene, color, and final lock frame truth
identity source three-view is the only character structure truth; do not invent a new identity board beyond it
only regenerate storyboard for review; do not create redundant world or identity reference substitutes
IP enters around second 3, movement should feel cheerful and light
maple leaves fall naturally from tree branches
distant sun gradually rises to strengthen morning atmosphere
final 2 seconds reveal poster typography and brand layout via motion graphics
camera should include subtle push in / pull / floating motion, keep whole animation flowing
do not add extra characters or props that compete with the IP
